name: Memorydetective
description:
Hunt iOS memory leaks and investigate runtime performance from inside Claude Code. memorydetective bundles an MCP server with 28 tools for analyzing .memgraph and .trace files, plus
a /perf-investigate skill that routes you to the right playbook based on symptoms (leak, hang, jank, slow launch).

Key features:
- 34-pattern retain-cycle classifier covering SwiftUI (incl. @Observable, SwiftData, NavigationStack), Swift Concurrency, Combine, UIKit, Core Data, RxSwift, Realm, and Coordinator
pattern
- Every classification ships fixHint + staticAnalysisHint + a Swift before/after fixTemplate snippet
- Trace analysis: hangs, animation hitches, allocations, app launch, time profile
- compareTracesByPattern for CI gating against perf regressions
- 5 SourceKit-LSP-backed Swift source-bridging tools (find references, hover, definitions)
- macOS unified logging (logShow / logStream)
- 5 slash commands for direct invocation: /investigate-leak, /investigate-hangs, /investigate-jank, /investigate-launch, /verify-cycle-fix

Reads memgraphs exported from Xcode's Memory Graph Debugger and traces from xctrace. Ships as both a Claude Code plugin and a standalone npm package, so the same MCP server works in
Cursor, Cline, Claude Desktop, and Continue.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `perf-investigate` (Disciplined iOS performance + memory-leak investigation using the memorydetective MCP server) and **1 MCP server**, `memorydetective`.

Installs with `claude plugin install memorydetective@claude-community` from `carloshpdoc/memorydetective-plugin` (`plugins/memorydetective`).
